FAQs Learn More About Our Med Spa What’s the difference between a day spa and a med spa? Med spas offer many of the same great treatments as day spas, but with an important difference: they are performed by medically trained estheticians with the oversight of a medical director, using the latest research and advanced technology for enhanced results. Our patients appreciate having access to both traditional spa services and more advanced cosmetic treatments—all in one place. And it makes perfect sense! Our bodies require different levels of care throughout the year, and having these options ensures you get exactly what you need when you need it. At our medispa in Dover, we pride ourselves on being the perfect blend of traditional spa services and advanced cosmetic and wellness treatments. Located within the same building as Dermatology & Skin Health, we offer immediate access to advanced dermatological treatments performed by board-certified dermatologists. What is there to do in Dover? For patients traveling to our medispa in Dover for an unforgettable day of relaxation and rejuvenation, we have a few recommendations to help you make the most of your trip: Shopping . If you’re a coffee aficionado, don’t miss the New Hampshire Coffee Roasting Company—the perfect spot to grab a piping hot Americano after your day at the spa. For those with a green thumb, Wentworth Greenhouses is worth a visit to explore their vast selection of houseplants, from golden pothos to snake plants and more. And if you have a sweet tooth, you simply can’t skip Lickee’s and Chewy’s Candies and Creamery. This award-winning, medieval-themed candy shop will delight both kids and adults alike. Walking & Biking . Add a bit of exercise to your day by exploring the Dover Community Trail, starting at the Watson Road Trailhead. This scenic trail is perfect for a relaxing hike, no matter the season. Plus, staying active is key to wellness: according to the CDC, adults need at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity physical activity per week—that’s just 30 minutes a day, five days a week! And as our board-certified dermatologists will tell you, don’t forget your sunscreen while you’re out and about. Regular application of sunscreen is essential to protect your skin from harmful UV rays during long periods of outdoor activity. Dining . Looking for a great place to eat while visiting Dover? For a taste of the region’s finest, we highly recommend Newick’s Lobster House on Dover Point Road for their famous lobster roll. For something more casual, try Tucker’s Breakfast & Lunch, where you can’t go wrong with their made-to-order eggs. If you’re craving pizza, head over to La Festa Brick & Brew Pizzeria for a slice you won’t soon forget. What sets you apart in the Dover Area? Poised Expertise Patients can expect their cosmetic treatments to be performed by board-certified practitioners and highly trained providers. We are committed to ensuring a safe, satisfying, and pleasurable experience with every procedure. Comprehensive Solutions Our medispa is equipped with state-of-the-art technology and innovative methods to provide a wide range of cosmetic treatments, making us your ultimate destination for all things beauty. Luxurious Experiences We strive to make your visit to Skin Health Medi Spa as relaxing as possible. Enjoy our range of salon and skincare services designed to provide you with the pampering you deserve. Personable Interactions At Skin Health Medi Spa, you’ll be greeted by our friendly and dedicated team of physicians, estheticians, hair stylists, and massage therapists. Your relaxation starts here, and we’re excited to make your experience truly enjoyable. Can I request an appointment online? Absolutely! You can easily request an appointment through our website at any time. Plus, discover your perfect treatment match using our simple and user-friendly Virtual Consultation Tool.
